# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-dataset-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'set NAME TYPE FILE': a set the configuration names, its file beside.
set names string datasets/names.lst
set unsets string datasets/names.lst
set reps string datasets/reputation.lst
set plain string datasets/names.lst
set mixed string datasets/mixed.lst
set latemix string datasets/late-mix.lst
set md5s md5 datasets/md5.lst
set shas sha256 datasets/sha256.lst
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when flow N was flushed at the end of
# the capture, its last address byte being N, then 'proto N NAME': the
# application protocol Suricata logged for flow N.
rule 12000 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12000"; dns.query; dataset:isset,names;)
rule 12001 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12001"; dns.query; dataset:isnotset,names;)
rule 12002 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12002"; dns.query; dataset:isset,names, type string;)
refused 12003 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12003"; dns.query; dataset:isset,names, type md5;)
refused 12004 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12004"; dns.query; dataset:isset,nobody;)
rule 12005 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12005"; dns.query; dataset:isset,later, type string;)
rule 12006 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12006"; dns.query; content:"example"; dataset:set,later;)
rule 12007 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12007"; dns.query; dataset:isset,later;)
rule 12008 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12008"; dns.query; dataset:unset,unsets;)
rule 12009 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12009"; dns.query; dataset:isset,unsets;)
rule 12010 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12010"; dns.query; datarep:reps, >, 10;)
rule 12011 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12011"; dns.query; datarep:reps, <, 10;)
rule 12012 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12012"; dns.query; datarep:reps, ==, 5;)
refused 12013 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12013"; dns.query; datarep:reps, =, 20;)
refused 12014 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12014"; dns.query; datarep:reps, >=, 5;)
refused 12015 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12015"; dns.query; datarep:reps, <=, 5;)
refused 12016 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12016"; dns.query; datarep:reps, !=, 5;)
rule 12017 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12017"; dns.query; datarep:plain, ==, 0;)
rule 12018 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12018"; dns.query; dataset:isset,reps;)
rule 12019 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12019"; dns.query; datarep:mixed, ==, 5;)
rule 12020 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12020"; dns.query; dataset:isset,mixed;)
rule 12021 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12021"; dns.query; to_md5; dataset:isset,md5s;)
rule 12022 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12022"; dns.query; dataset:isset,md5s;)
rule 12023 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12023"; dns.query; to_sha256; dataset:isset,shas;)
rule 12024 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12024"; dns.query; dataset:isset,names, memcap 10mb, hashsize 1024;)
rule 12025 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12025"; dns.query; content:"evil"; dataset:set,fresh, type sha256;)
rule 12026 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12026"; dns.query; to_sha256; dataset:set,fresh2, type sha256;)
rule 12027 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12027"; dns.query; to_sha256; dataset:isset,fresh2;)
refused 12028 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12028"; dataset:isset,names;)
rule 12029 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12029"; dns.query; dataset:isset,latemix;)
rule 12030 alert dns any any -> any any (msg:"dataset 12030"; dns.query; dataset:isset,names, type string, load names.lst;)
